source.title: Lurgan Mail, 29 April 1933, p. 3 ("Lurgan Rural Council")
source.publisher: Lurgan Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names from the OCR text, which is clean; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (ten electoral divisions), 1933: there was no election. The report prints no party labels. Returned unopposed. No nomination was sent in; the member for the division, G. W. Annesley, continued under the rule that a retiring councillor is deemed re-elected where no nomination is made.
